ACT VIII OF 2004
ACT VIII OF 2004
SINDH TAX EVASION
(PUNISHMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act to amend
the Sindh Tax Evasion (Punishment) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 11th June, 2004]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-3/2004, dated
11-6-2004.--The Sindh Tax .Evasion (Punishment) (Amendment) Bill, 2004;
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th April, 2004 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 31st May, 2004, is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Tax Evasion
(Punishment) (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3 of Sind Act No.XXXIX, of 1974

ACT VIII OF 2004
ACT VIII OF 2004
SINDH TAX EVASION
(PUNISHMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act to amend
the Sindh Tax Evasion (Punishment) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 11th June, 2004]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-3/2004, dated
11-6-2004.--The Sindh Tax .Evasion (Punishment) (Amendment) Bill, 2004;
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th April, 2004 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 31st May, 2004, is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Sind Act No.XXXIX, of 1974.--In the Sindh Tax Evasion (Punishment) Act,
1974, hereinafter referred to as the said Act in section 3 in subsection (1),
the full stop at the end shall be replaced by a colon and thereafter the
following proviso shall be added.
"Provided that imprisonment
for contravention of sections 9 and 10 of the Sindh Finance Act, 1994 shall be
for a term which may extend to six months."

Amendment of Schedule of the Sind Act XXIX of 1974
